headline: Fronts Intensify as Bases Shift Across Six Sectors
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the map’s hottest theatres have reshuffled. Weathered Expanse has surged further, recording eleven ownership changes in the past two hours and thirty‑eight for the day, with casualties climbing to roughly 970 Colonial and 810 Warden per hour and enlistments accelerating to eighty‑two per hour. Stlican Shelf remains the busiest sector, adding two flips in the latest window and forty‑six total, its casualty rate steady near 115 Colonial and 120 Warden per hour. Godcrofts, quiet in the prior report, now logs six flips in two hours and nineteen daily, casualties spiking to four hundred Colonial and six hundred Warden per hour. Stonecradle erupts with three fresh flips and twenty‑four overall, both sides losing near five hundred men per hour. Oarbreaker sees three recent changes, casualties rising sharply to nearly two hundred Colonial and three hundred Warden per hour. Deadlands, previously volatile, shows no new two‑hour activity but retains eighteen daily flips and a high casualty stream of three hundred Colonial and four hundred Warden per hour. The deep Warden interior and the Colonial southern fringe stay unchanged.
